clue.text: Break from desire to hurt after religious education

indicators.note: 'after' places the desire to hurt behind the religious education in the finished word

parts.note: RE is the school-subject abbreviation for religious education
malice, the wish to wound someone

explanation.surface: Someone takes time out from a spiteful mood once their religion lesson is over.
explanation.definitionFit: A respite is a short pause or interval of relief, the same as a break from something unpleasant.

clue.text: About to get bike and make into something new

parts.note: re means concerning, about
a bicycle

explanation.surface: Someone is about to buy a bicycle and give it a makeover.
explanation.definitionFit: Recycling turns waste material into fresh usable products, converting old things into new ones.

clue.text: Coach returned to prison and took in food for master

indicators.note: returned means going back the way it came, so the coach word reads backwards

parts.note: a coach is a long-distance bus

explanation.surface: A prisoner is driven back to jail and fed, all for the governor's sake.
explanation.definitionFit: To subjugate is to conquer and bring under control, which is what mastering a people means.

clue.text: Angry traitor that is embraced

indicators.note: embraced means held inside arms, so the traitor goes inside the other piece

parts.note: i.e. is Latin id est, that is
a rat is someone who betrays

explanation.surface: A furious turncoat, so to speak, gets a hug.
explanation.definitionFit: Irate is a direct synonym for furious or cross, describing someone in a temper.

clue.text: Dish left in ruined hacienda

parts.note: a Spanish ranch house, taken as written
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: Leftover food sits in a wrecked Mexican ranch house.
explanation.definitionFit: An enchilada is a Mexican tortilla rolled round a filling and baked in sauce, a dish.

clue.text: Unpopular job in remote area

parts.note: out of favour, no longer in fashion
a post is a position of employment

clue.text: No uncertainty bottling small measure

indicators.note: bottling means holding inside, so the words keep the target within them

parts.note: found across the join of the two words

explanation.surface: Certainly put just a little in the bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: An ounce is a small imperial unit of weight, about twenty-eight grams, so a small amount.

clue.text: President and journo raise fake

parts.note: Donald Trump, US president
ed, editor
to up something is to increase it

explanation.surface: A president and a reporter push some false story higher.
explanation.definitionFit: Trumped-up charges are invented or concocted, which is what fake means here.

clue.text: Surpass alfresco party

parts.note: alfresco means outdoors
a do is a party

explanation.surface: An outdoor party that beats all others.
explanation.definitionFit: To outdo is to do better than a rival, exceeding or beating their performance.

clue.text: Explosive device dropped regularly amidst commotion

indicators.note: amidst puts the kept letters in the middle of the commotion word

parts.note: a to-do is a fuss

indicators.note: regularly means at even intervals, so every other letter of the word is kept

parts.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters

explanation.surface: A bomb is let fall at intervals in the middle of chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: A torpedo is a self-propelled underwater missile that explodes on striking a ship.

clue.text: Firm support for reptile

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
an undergarment that supports

explanation.surface: A company announces that it backs some cold-blooded creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The cobra is a venomous hooded snake, and snakes are one kind of reptile.

clue.text: Study tube or train fare collector

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
a pipe or channel
taken as written

explanation.surface: Looks like a choice between the Underground and an ordinary railway for someone who collects fares.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tube or train' reads as a choice of transport; the tube is a duct and 'train' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: On railways and buses the conductor is the official who checks tickets and takes payment from passengers.

clue.text: Sauté rice vigorously and burn

indicators.note: vigorous stirring tosses things about, so the letters end up thrown into a new arrangement

parts.note: the letters of both words used together

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction: fry the rice hard and let it catch on the pan.
explanation.definitionFit: To cauterise is to seal tissue by searing it with heat or chemicals, a medical kind of burning.

clue.text: Quietly urged daughter to leave show

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical mark for quietly

indicators.note: the daughter departing means her letter is taken out of the word for urged

parts.note: drove means pushed or urged on
standard abbreviation for daughter

explanation.definitionFit: To prove something is to demonstrate or establish it, which is what showing it to be true means.

clue.text: Faithful old performance

parts.note: ex means former
a turn or routine on stage

explanation.surface: Praise for a loyal veteran show still put on the way it always was.
explanation.definitionFit: A faithful copy or translation is one that is precise and accurate, true to the original in every detail.

clue.text: Elite lot illegitimately securing right to lead

indicators.note: securing means holding fast, so the jumble holds the right letter inside
illegitimately means not by proper rules, so the letters are wrongly arranged

parts.note: the letters of both words
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A privileged group dishonestly grabs the right to be in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lead' looks like a verb about leadership; in theatre it is the starring part.
explanation.definitionFit: The title role is the part named in a play's title, usually the leading part in a production.

clue.text: I alarm old doddery creature

indicators.note: something doddery is shaky and unsteady, so these letters wobble out of their order

parts.note: the letters of all three words together

explanation.surface: A frail elderly animal confesses it is easily frightened, or frightening.
explanation.definitionFit: The armadillo is an armoured burrowing mammal of the Americas, so it is a particular animal.

clue.text: Create period of work, using whatever is available

parts.note: to make is to create
a stint of work time

explanation.surface: Someone builds a work rota from whatever staff they have.
explanation.definitionFit: Makeshift describes something improvised as a temporary substitute from materials close to hand.

clue.text: Delayed accepting one pound as pay off

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the delayed word holds the money inside

parts.note: behind time
Roman numeral one
quid is British slang for a pound sterling

explanation.surface: A late payer hands over a single pound to settle up.
explanation.definitionFit: To liquidate a debt is to settle it in full, clearing what is owed.

clue.text: Follow someone around small town initially to flatter

indicators.note: the word for follow someone goes around the other pieces, enclosing them

parts.note: to stalk is to follow someone persistently
wee is Scottish for little

indicators.note: initially asks for only the opening letter of the word before it

parts.note: the first letter of town

explanation.surface: A stalker trails someone round a little town hoping to charm them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flatter' is a verb here, not a comparative of flat.
explanation.definitionFit: To sweet-talk someone is to coax them with compliments and persuasive charm, much as flattering does.

clue.text: Put an end to meal involving carbon

indicators.note: involving means including within, so the meal word takes the element inside

parts.note: an evening meal
C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: Someone halts a dinner on account of burnt food.
explanation.definitionFit: To scupper plans is to wreck or thwart them, bringing them to a halt.

clue.text: Animosity summit announced

indicators.note: announced means said out loud, so we want a word that sounds like the summit word

parts.note: a peak is the top of a mountain

explanation.walkthrough: 'Summit' suggests a diplomatic meeting; here it is a mountain top.
explanation.definitionFit: Pique is resentment or irritation from wounded pride, a mild form of hostility or ill will.

clue.text: Beseech topless males to provide something for free

indicators.note: topless in a down clue means the first letter is lost from the males word

parts.note: men are males
a treat is something paid for by another

explanation.definitionFit: To entreat is to ask earnestly or plead with someone, the same as beseeching them.

clue.text: Relative, losing head, let loose

indicators.note: losing its head means the relative's first letter is cut off

parts.note: an aunt, familiarly

explanation.surface: A family member loses their temper and runs riot.
explanation.definitionFit: To untie is to undo knots or bonds, freeing whatever was tied up.

clue.text: Infant excited to perform addition

parts.note: a tot is a small child
up means lively, in high spirits

explanation.surface: A small child is thrilled to do some sums.
explanation.definitionFit: To tot up is to add numbers together to reach a total, a sum calculation.

clue.text: Rough patch is on hole in the wall

indicators.note: rough means crude and disordered, so the letters come out roughly rearranged

parts.note: the letters of all three words together

explanation.surface: A bad stretch for someone ends in a hole in a wall, like a builder's woes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hole in the wall' is British slang for a street cash machine, which in Britain is also called a cashpoint.
explanation.definitionFit: Both names refer to an automated teller machine set into a building's outside wall for withdrawing money.

clue.text: Preserves antidotes

definitions.meaning: first meaning: treats meat or fish by salting, smoking or drying
second meaning: remedies that heal an illness

explanation.walkthrough: 'Preserves' looks like jam, a noun; here it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for salting or smoking food to keep it and a plural noun for remedies.

clue.text: Climbing perennial plants cover area of level land

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means rising up the grid, read bottom to top
the plants cover the target, which lies concealed inside the words

parts.note: the letters spanning the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: Climbing perennials smother a stretch of flat ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain is a large expanse of flat open land without hills, like prairie or steppe.

clue.text: Fragrant mixture of cannabis, rain and core of durian

parts.note: the two central letters of durian

explanation.walkthrough: The durian is a notoriously foul-smelling Asian fruit, a joke against 'fragrant'.
explanation.definitionFit: Potpourri is a bowl of dried petals and spices kept to perfume a room, a scented blend.

clue.text: A labyrinth to shock and awe

parts.note: taken as written
a maze is a network of confusing paths

explanation.surface: A puzzling garden maze built to astonish visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shock and awe' recalls a military doctrine; here it simply means astound.
explanation.definitionFit: To amaze is to astonish greatly, filling someone with surprise and wonder.

clue.text: Gunmen on jetty with small arms

a landing stage reaching into water

explanation.definitionFit: Rapiers are slender thrusting swords, and swords are weapons, which arms means.

clue.text: Beat man to line

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to thrash them
a gentleman
